gl:definition.gl:content: salted cryptographic commitment to the parent, recorded in the child's event log, by which a child satisfies the bidirectional parent-knowledge requirement without disclosing the identity of the parent

gl:notes.gl:content: Proof of binding is distinct from knowledge of parent: verifiable modes establish that the child is validly installed in some parent under a given profile (warranty, compliance) without revealing which parent; full disclosure occurs only by ceremony.
An optional escrow envelope under a threshold trustee (concept dpp-0137) accompanies the commitment where future disclosure must remain possible.
